description: Recorded Anthropic /v1/messages streaming exchange that dies with an IN-BAND `error` event (WU-14b): the stream opens 200, delivers the opening events and one text fragment, then emits the uniform error envelope as an SSE event (`overloaded_error`) and closes WITHOUT message_stop. The canonical stream surfaces the wire-shaped ERROR chunk (ErrorInfo: canonical taxonomy code `transient` + verbatim native payload + retryable, rule 8) and NO terminal is synthesized — the accumulator's aborted-stream sealing is the honest downstream. Synthetic, wire-accurate against ErrorEvent/StreamError (wire.py); replayed via respx (rule 10).
